hints.title: Prefix Maximum State Formulation
hints.text: The search cost increments only when choosing a number strictly greater than all previous numbers in the prefix.

hints.title: Three-Dimensional Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Define dp[i][j][c] as the number of valid arrays of length i having prefix maximum j and search cost c.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Transition Optimization
hints.text: Either pick a number <= j (j choices, cost unchanged), or pick a number v > j (1 choice per v, cost increments). Accumulate transitions modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix sum accumulation optimizes inner transition from O(M^2) to O(M).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating M^N arrays takes astronomical time even for modest values of N=50.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 2D table reduces memory footprint to O(M * K).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prefix-sum optimized 3D dynamic programming with rolling space optimization.
